items.title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: Anthropic 数学家称借助 Claude 用 Lean 证明黎曼猜想
items.title_en: Anthropic mathematician claims Claude proved the Riemann Hypothesis in Lean
items.summary: A Lean formal verification effort purportedly covering the Riemann Hypothesis and large swaths of modern mathematics, drawing intense discussion about proof-checker trust, AI-assisted formalization, and the significance for math foundations.

items.title: 浙江大学首次在真机上实现量子随机存储器 QRAM
items.title_zh: 浙大首次在真机上实现量子随机存储器 QRAM
items.title_en: Zhejiang University Demonstrates First Real-Hardware QRAM on Superconducting Chip
items.summary: Zhejiang University researchers demonstrated a working QRAM prototype on the superconducting quantum chip Tianmu-2, marking the first real-hardware implementation of quantum random access memory.

items.title: RCE in Gnupg
items.title_zh: GnuPG 的 GPGME 存在双重释放漏洞，被标为 RCE 且波及大量下游软件
items.title_en: GPGME Double-Free Flaw in GnuPG Labeled RCE, Wide Downstream Impact
items.summary: A double-free vulnerability in GPGME (pre-2.3.0) billed as an RCE affecting GnuPG and a wide range of downstream software, with HN commenters debating severity labeling, disclosure timelines, and the downstream patch that predated the upstream fix.
